processor/memory-tool.mjs: Loads and validates a complete snapshot before validation, context retrieval or statistics. Dispatches completed-candidate merges.
parseSource: Parses canonical observation headers, checks identity and computes the exact UTF-8 SHA-256.
loadMemory: Loads graph, sources, ledger, queues, hypotheses and canonical layout.
run: Parses CLI options, validates state and dispatches the selected operation.
processor/process.py: Creates evidence/UUID.json from inbox observations. Existing evidence is skipped. interpretation is not_inferred; indexing never creates semantic claims.
processor/init-instance.py: Creates a fresh canonical graph v2, hypotheses v1, ledger, idle lease, queues, purpose and directories. --profile creates and selects a profile stub. Refuses a nonempty destination.
server/memory-model.mjs: Validates graph structure, provenance and history; retrieves lexical context with bounded graph expansion; computes statistics, capacity and review warnings.
schemaErrors: Bounded JSON Schema evaluator; unknown schema keywords fail closed.
validateMemory: Checks references, exact quotations, source hashes, ledger parity, correction history and dependencies.
retrieveContext: Applies temporal policy, exact scoped identifiers and lexical/graph retrieval.
memoryStats: Totals, pending counts, relation counts, UTC timeline and capacity.
collectWarnings: Advisory findings; does not establish truth.
server/core-policies.mjs: Declarative vocabulary, scoped identity matching, acyclic dependency checks, conflict warnings and temporal selection. No executable policy hooks.
validateVocabulary: Validates vocabulary v2 and bounded lists.
temporalSelection: Selects effective intervals and current single-valued claims, preserving explicit alternatives.
requireCapabilities: Requires candidate-validation-v1 and core-policies-v2 by default.
server/hypotheses.mjs: Validates strict hypothesis records, source and claim references, confidence bounds, collection timestamps and status evidence requirements.
server/application-profile.mjs: Loads explicitly selected core guidance, kind-scoped sections and vocabulary. Retains exact hashes and delivered text provenance; rejects unsafe paths and engine-contained data.
loadProfile: Accepts an optional immutable-snapshot reader and batch kinds; returns guidance, boundary, version and optional vocabulary.
readInstanceFile: Reads regular UTF-8 data outside the engine without symlink traversal.
server/instance-layout.mjs: Resolves required canonical purpose and hypothesis paths; missing files fail. No legacy layout conversion.
server/candidate-merge.mjs: Three-way ID-keyed merge of same-base completed snapshots. Enforces immutable byte/history rules, flags summary regeneration and produces a private review draft. Never publishes or manages leases.
server/subprocess.mjs: Runs noninteractive child processes with bounded execution and output. Used by Git operations and fixtures.
adapters/reference-git/adapter.mjs: Six-command adapter with lease ownership, exact candidate validation, private index, expected-head CAS publication and interrupted-publication recovery. Dedicated local instance repository only.
createAdapter: Factory accepting instance, harness, Git/Node executables, clock and test hooks.
run: CLI entry point for status, claim, renew, validate, commit and release-error.
adapters/template/adapter.mjs: Explicitly failing delegation scaffold for an application-owned backend. Supplies the interface, not working storage.
integration/install-host.py: Verifies release manifest hashes and installs an intact engine plus managed host instructions. Preserves unrelated application content; refuses conflicting installations.
integration/install-codex.py: Host entry point for Codex CLI/Desktop; calls shared installer. Discovery must be checked in a fresh client session.
integration/install-cursor.py: Installs shared instructions and an alwaysApply Cursor MDC rule. It does not initialize memory or start inference.
tools/build-release.py: Runs release checks, stages an explicit distribution file list, creates RELEASE.json, ZIP and SHA-256 checksum. Maintainer tooling, not instance processing.
tools/benchmark-capacity.mjs: Synthetic measurement of validators, retrieval and adapter operations within documented platform and byte limits.
tools/measure-cli.mjs: Measures command execution for capacity reporting.
tools/intake-example.mjs: Synthetic intake demonstration; host-owned ingestion remains outside the core.
processor/write-candidate.mjs: Assembles graph/index/journal drafts from an agent-authored structured change set. Preview by default; checks base hashes, source bytes and owned lease. Does not publish or write leases/ledger.
server/operation-metrics.mjs: Opt-in monotonic phase timings and Git counters with fixed labels; no arguments, source text, paths or credentials collected.
tools/benchmark-cycle.mjs: Synthetic realistic-size 5/10/20-source cycle probes using fresh adapters. Measures deterministic operations, not LLM inference.
